evidence.quote: Every new Indigenous hire is offered a formal sponsor from senior leadership for their first two years. Sponsors meet with them monthly and advocate for stretch assignments.
Promotion decisions use published, objective criteria for each level.
Panels score candidates against those criteria and record the reasons for each decision. Records are kept for three years and reviewed each year for disparities.
The Indigenous Employee Circle has an annual budget, paid meeting time for members and an executive sponsor.

reasoning: The policy describes a formal senior-leadership sponsorship for new Indigenous hires, promotion decisions based on published objective criteria with recorded reasons and annual disparity reviews, and a budgeted Indigenous Employee Circle with an executive sponsor. Pay transparency itself is not specifically described beyond the promotion documentation.
